identity.resolvedIdentity: The protected late-Baroque manor house and immediate historic estate complex beside Sarpsfossen, distinct from Hafslund power station, the modern company and the full former estate.
identity.identityProblem: The Hafslund name covers a manor, farm locality, district, company and power facilities. The record must be anchored to the historic manor house while retaining the wider resource landscape as context.
identity.splitReason: The main house, park and immediate outbuildings form one coherent destination. The power station and wider industrial landscape are separate places.
